youtube_description:
Pathra Cadness is a Thai-New Zealander Hearthstone streamer based in Paris, France who recently represented her national country New Zealand at the Hearthstone Global Games.

Our reporter Adam Neylan takes some time for an interview with Pathra at BlizzCon 2018 following the end of the 2018 Hearthstone Global Games to get her thoughts on competing, streaming, Artifact and more.
